methodology: One unretried 10-workflow by 7-model live matrix. Original verdicts retained without post-run rescoring. These are strict suite outcomes, not measured whole-product compatibility.
limitations: No native-provider A/B reference was executed, per the requested fixed 70-case scope.
C03 uses a strict JSON-only oracle and an ambiguous empty (empty.txt) prompt field; formatting/type failures are not sufficient evidence of a bridge defect.
C03 command recognition is narrower than valid Git syntax (git -c ... diff).
Tool budgets are scored as pass conditions, so extra verification commands can fail an otherwise correct workflow.
C05 requires a nonzero initial shell exit: pipelines without pipefail can conceal a failing test exit.
C10 requires the exact receipt value including its prefix; retaining only the nonce does not pass.
No model reached 10/10. No core-10-compatible or whole-product 90% claim is established.
